theater: 洞庭湖西汊與湘水下游

battle.name: 陽武口之戰
battle.theater: 洞庭湖西汊與湘水下游
battle.brief: 紹興三年十月至十一月，王𤫉率三萬禁軍與荊潭水軍入洞庭湖討楊幺，舟師先敗於橋口；十一月初十，崔增、吳全所部數百舟船入湖追擊，至陽武口水面忽寬，楊幺車船水軍擂鼓橫衝，將宋軍舟船盡數撞沉，萬餘人覆沒。卡面配重投石車未參戰：本役是水戰，無城牆可攻，決定勝負的是車船與水寨工程。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是南宋朝廷的湖南水軍與自建楚國號的洞庭水軍。南宋一方以荊南、潭鼎澧岳制置使王𤫉為統帥，紹興三年六月受命，領所部三萬禁軍及御前統制、神武後軍統制五千人，調韓世忠所部五百只舟船並攜五個月糧食同行，又節制荊潭制置司水軍吳全所部兵萬餘人、戰船數百，指揮系統自荊南、潭鼎澧岳四州水軍延伸到鄂州江防。楚軍一方領袖楊幺，原為洞庭湖漁戶出身，宣和末年鍾相起義失敗後收拾湖中餘眾，紹興元年、二年間在鼎口、下沚江口兩度擊退知鼎州程昌寓的進攻，環洞庭湖分據水寨數十處，並造車船、海鰍船數百只，兵農相兼、陸耕水戰，紹興三年四月更奉鍾相少子鍾子義為太子，自號大聖天王，建楚政權，其地北至公安、西至鼎澧、東達岳州、南抵潭州。楚軍的指揮核心是楊幺與各水寨首領，無固定員額，遇戰則以舟隊集結於汊口，散則退守水寨與洲渚。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Hunan water forces of the Southern Song court and the Dongting water army that had set up a state of Chu. On the Song side the command was held by Wang Gui, appointed Commander-in-Chief over Jingnan and the circuits of Tanzhou, Dingzhou, Yuezhou and Lizhou in the sixth month of Shaoxing, 1133. He brought with him thirty thousand of the imperial guard and five thousand men of the Household Command and of the Shenzhou rear command, together with five hundred boats drawn from Han Shizhong units and five months of grain, and he took command of the Jingtan circuit water force under Wu Quan, more than ten thousand men and several hundred war junks. His chain of command ran from the water forces of the four circuits of Jingnan, Tanzhou, Dingzhou, Yuezhou and Lizhou out to the river defence of Ezhou. The other side was led by Yang Yao, a man of the lake shores who had been a fisherman, who took over the remnants on Dongting after the failure of the rising begun by Zhong Xiang in the last years of the Xuanhe era. Between the first and second years of Shaoxing he twice beat back an attack by Cheng Changyu, the governor of Dingzhou, at Dingkou and at Xiazhi Jiang, then ringed Dongting Lake with some dozens of stockaded camps, and had several hundred craft built, traction-wheel ships and sea-loach junks, so that his men farmed the land and fought on the water at the same time. In the fourth month of 1133 he further installed Zhong Xiang younger son Zhong Ziyi as heir, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Heavenly King, and set up the government of Chu over territory reaching north to Gong an, west to Ding and Li, east to Yuezhou and south to Tanzhou. The command core of the Chu army was Yang Yao together with the chiefs of the stockades; there was no fixed establishment, for in battle the fleets mustered at the mouths of the channels, and when dispersed they fell back on the stockades and the islets.
people: 本役最關鍵的宋方人物是王𤫉，他以荊南、潭鼎澧岳制置使之銜統兵，紹興三年十月率水軍至岳州，自水路下游進兵，另派統制官右世達率二千兵抵達鼎州，與程昌寓所部在上游會合，企圖兩面夾擊；他本人領神武前軍萬餘人陸行至鼎州，改從上游進剿，並留兵設伏於洞庭湖口、牌口等處，專候楚軍敗退時攔殺。十月十九日，統制官王燮率軍出擊，與楊幺車船水軍短兵相接，宋軍舟船矮小不敵車船，敗退橋口。十一月，崔增、吳全率數百舟船入湖追擊，於陽武口全軍覆沒，是本役宋方最重的損失。另一名關鍵人物是知州程昌寓：他早於紹興元年以知鼎州身分在鼎口、下沚江口抵禦楚軍，紹興三年再與王𤫉水陸並進，自下沚江口逐寨圍剿，卻見沿湖水寨皆空，才為楚軍所乘。楚方領袖楊幺則以將計就計扭轉戰局：先將上游諸寨民眾、牲畜轉移至酉港，以部分水軍牽制上游宋軍，再令數千人乘車船數隻偃旗息鼓順流東下，於陽武口水闊處集中撞擊宋軍舟船，最後班師回酉港，會合車船水軍再敗王𤫉主力。須加分辨的是，崔增、吳全並非義軍首領，吳全為荊潭制置司水軍指揮官，與官軍同屬一方。
peopleEn: The decisive Song figure was Wang Gui, who led the expedition as Commander-in-Chief over Jingnan, Tanzhou, Dingzhou, Yuezhou and Lizhou. In the tenth month of 1133 he brought his water force up to Yuezhou and advanced by the lower reaches of the waterway, at the same time sending the commander You Shida with two thousand men up to Dingzhou to join Cheng Changyu upstream, in order to pinch the Chu army from two ends. He himself led more than ten thousand of the Shenzhou front command overland to Dingzhou, switched to advancing from the upper reaches, and left troops in ambush at the mouth of Dongting Lake and at Paikou, waiting for the routed Chu to retreat so that they could be cut down. On the nineteenth day of the tenth month the commander Wang Xie led a sortie and fought the Chu traction-wheel flotilla at close quarters; the Song boats were low and could not stand up to the traction-wheel ships, and they were beaten back to Qiaokou. In the eleventh month Cui Zeng and Wu Quan took several hundred boats into the lake in pursuit and were annihilated at Yangwukou, the heaviest loss the Song suffered in the campaign. Another key figure was the governor Cheng Changyu: back in the first year of Shaoxing he had already held off the Chu at Dingkou and Xiazhi Jiang as governor of Dingzhou, and in 1133 he again advanced with Wang Gui by land and water out of Xiazhi Jiang, hunting down the lakeside stockades one by one, only to find every camp he reached already empty. The Chu leader Yang Yao turned the tables with a counter-stroke: he first moved the people and livestock of the upstream stockades to Yougang, kept part of his water force engaged with the Song troops upstream, then sent several thousand men down the stream in a few traction-wheel ships with flags furled and drums silent, to concentrate on the Song fleet at Yangwukou where the water suddenly widened, and finally returned to Yougang, gathered the traction-wheel fleet and defeated Wang Gui main body a second time. It should be noted that Cui Zeng and Wu Quan were not insurgent chiefs: Wu Quan commanded the water force of the Jingtan circuit and belonged to the Song side.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車並沒有出現在一一三三年的洞庭湖上：本役是水戰，既無城牆可攻，也無固定基座可立。配重投石車是十二世紀初在地中海世界出現的新器械，長臂末端懸配重箱，靠重錘下墜帶動長臂甩起，把石彈拋越城牆，操作不過數人、機關穩定，可反覆拋射，歐洲的攻城戰自此改寫尺度；它真正傳入中土，要到十三世紀蒙古軍把中亞與波斯工匠帶進中原之後，以回回砲之名出現在宋金戰場，於襄陽攻守戰中大放異彩。與之同時的中國攻城器械是北宋《武經總要》所載砲石車，橫臂、靠數十人以至百餘人挽索發射，一發之後須重新整理裝填，射程與精度都受人力牽制。楊幺軍隊真正倚重的工程技術全在水上：車船以人力踏輪帶動，船上可載士卒並向岸寨施弓弩戈矛，是對付宋軍舟隊的主力；海鰍船是低窄快速的戰鬥舟型，專供衝突與追擊；再配合水寨木柵、攔江木障與浮排，封鎖湖汊、斷絕官軍航道。同一場戰爭裡，歐洲工程靠配重砸開城牆，洞庭工程靠踏輪與水寨封死水面，兩種思路在本役構成對照。
kitsEn: The counterweight trebuchet on the card did not appear on Dongting Lake in 1133: this was a war on the water, with no wall to attack and no fixed base on which to stand. The counterweight trebuchet was a new machine that appeared in the Mediterranean world in the early twelfth century: a counterweight box hung at the end of a long arm, and the fall of the weight drove the arm up to throw a stone over the wall, needing only a few men to work it and a stable mechanism that could be fired again and again, and it rewrote the scale of siege warfare in Europe. It really entered the Chinese mainland only in the thirteenth century, when Mongol armies brought craftsmen from Central Asia and Persia, and it then appeared on Song and Jin battlefields under the name of the Huihui pao and made its name in the siege of Xiangyang. The Chinese siege machine of the same age was the stone-throwing engine of the Northern Song military manual Wujing Zongyao, of the horizontal-arm type, hauled by ropes pulled by dozens or even more than a hundred men, which had to be reset after every shot, so that both range and accuracy were at the mercy of human muscle. The engineering that Yang Yao army truly relied on lay entirely on the water. The traction-wheel ship was moved by men treading wheels, carried soldiers aboard, and could put bows, crossbows and spears to work against the shore stockades; it was the main weapon against the Song flotilla. The sea-loach junks were low, narrow and fast craft built for collision and pursuit. With them went wooden palisades at the stockades, log barriers across the channels and floating rafts that sealed the waterways and cut the Song route. In the same war, European engineering broke walls with counterweights while Dongting engineering sealed the water with treadwheels and stockades, and the two ideas stand in contrast.
tactics: 官軍的打法是分進合擊、由兩端夾湖：水軍主力自岳州沿水路下游進兵，另派統制官右世達率二千兵抵達鼎州，與程昌寓所部在上游會合，企圖把楚軍擠在洞庭湖中段。楊幺的應對完全順著湖性而來。他不與官軍爭寬闊水面，而是把主力泊在汊口、洲渚與水寨之間，把上游諸寨的民眾、牲畜先移往酉港，令宋軍攻到的盡是空寨；同時以部分水軍在上游牽制宋軍，令數千人乘車船數隻偃旗息鼓順流東下，等宋軍舟隊追入水面忽寬的陽武口，才集中擂鼓橫衝，撞沉宋軍舟船。十月十九日王燮部在橋口的失敗，則是因宋軍舟船矮小、載兵有限，在短兵相接中不敵車船之高舷與撞力，被迫退保。十一月十日宋軍再以三萬步騎自下沚江口水陸並進，逐寨圍剿，結果因判斷錯誤，把追擊當成了殘敵清剿。楚軍另一套是水寨與封鎖：分據水寨數十處，環湖互為犄角，舟隊可以隨時進入官軍兵力薄弱的汊口，把大軍拖成小股消耗；宋軍則被迫以大隊護小隊、步步為營，士氣與糧秣都在水路上被拉長。
tacticsEn: The Song plan was to advance in two columns and close on the lake from both ends: the main fleet came up the waterway to Yuezhou and advanced from the lower reaches, while the commander You Shida took two thousand men to Dingzhou to join Cheng Changyu upstream, in order to squeeze the Chu army in the middle of Dongting. Yang Yao answer followed the nature of the lake exactly. He did not contest the open water with the Song; he kept his main force moored among the channel mouths, the islets and the stockades, moved the people and livestock of the upstream camps away to Yougang in advance so that the Song found nothing but empty camps wherever they attacked, and while part of his water force held the Song upstream, he sent several thousand men down the current in a few traction-wheel ships with flags furled and drums silent, waiting until the Song fleet had followed into Yangwukou, where the water suddenly widened, before drumming up and charging in a mass to ram the Song boats. The defeat at Qiaokou on the nineteenth day of the tenth month came because the Song boats were low, carried few men and, in close fighting, could not stand against the high sides and the ram of the traction-wheel ships. On the tenth day of the eleventh month the Song again moved forward with thirty thousand foot and horse out of Xiazhi Jiang, by land and water at once, hunting down the lakeside stockades one by one, and failed precisely because they had mistaken a pursuit for the mopping up of a broken enemy. The Chu also fought with stockades and blockade: dozens of camps ringed the lake and supported one another, and the fleets could enter at any moment the reaches where the Song had few troops, turning a great army into a grinding series of small engagements. The Song were forced on the other side to advance with a mass in support of small detachments, consolidating at every step, and both their morale and their supply lines were stretched along the waterways.
data: 本役可用的數字，多出自《續資治通鑑》卷一百十三所收記載，也有後出者的概括。楚軍方面：紹興元年、二年間，楊幺、夏城等在鼎口與下沚江口擊敗知鼎州程昌寓的進攻後，領軍數十萬，環洞庭湖分據水寨數十處，準備車船、海鰍船數百只，兵農相兼、陸耕水戰；所謂數十萬是宣稱之數，其中含兵農合一的人口，實際作戰兵力當遠少於此。紹興三年四月，楊幺奉鍾相少子鍾子義為太子，自號大聖天王，控地北至公安、西至鼎澧、東達岳州、南抵潭州。宋軍方面：紹興三年六月命王𤫉為荊南、潭鼎澧岳制置使，領三萬禁軍及御前統制、神武後軍統制五千人，調韓世忠五百只舟船、攜五個月糧食，節制吳全所部兵萬餘人、戰船數百；十月水軍至岳州，右世達率二千兵抵鼎州；十一月初十，崔增、吳全率數百舟船入湖，部眾萬餘人在陽武口全軍覆沒。地理上，陽武口在今岳陽市以西的洞庭湖中，下沚江口在今漢壽縣北，酉港在漢壽縣東北，橋口在湘陰縣西南湘江西岸，鼎口在今常德市東、沅水入湖之處。器械方面，車船與海鰍船合計數百只，一艘車船可載數十人並向岸寨施弓弩。
dataEn: Most of the usable figures for this campaign come from the record in the Xu Zizhi Tongjian, volume one hundred and thirteen, with additions from later compilers. On the Chu side: between the first and second years of Shaoxing, after Yang Yao, Xia Cheng and others had beaten the attack of Cheng Changyu, the governor of Dingzhou, at Dingkou and Xiazhi Jiang, they led tens of thousands around Dongting Lake and were posted at some dozens of stockaded camps, and had several hundred craft prepared, traction-wheel ships and sea-loach junks, so that the men farmed and fought at once. The figure of tens of thousands is a claimed number that folds the farming population into the army; the actual fighting force must have been much smaller. In the fourth month of 1133 Yang Yao installed Zhong Xiang younger son Zhong Ziyi as heir, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Heavenly King, and ruled over territory reaching north to Gong an, west to Ding and Li, east to Yuezhou and south to Tanzhou. On the Song side: in the sixth month of 1133 Wang Gui was appointed Commander-in-Chief over Jingnan, Tanzhou, Dingzhou, Yuezhou and Lizhou, with thirty thousand of the imperial guard and five thousand of the Household and Shenzhou rear commands, and he took five hundred boats from Han Shizhong and five months of grain, taking over the command of Wu Quan force of more than ten thousand men and several hundred war junks; in the tenth month his fleet reached Yuezhou and You Shida took two thousand men to Dingzhou; on the tenth day of the eleventh month Cui Zeng and Wu Quan took several hundred boats into the lake and more than ten thousand men were annihilated with them at Yangwukou. As to geography, Yangwukou lay in the western part of Dongting Lake west of present-day Yueyang, Xiazhi Jiang was north of present-day Hanshou, Yougang lay northeast of Hanshou, Qiaokou was on the west bank of the Xiang River southwest of present-day Xiangyin, and Dingkou was where the Yuan River enters the lake east of present-day Changde. On equipment, the traction-wheel ships and sea-loach junks together numbered several hundred, and a single traction-wheel ship could carry several dozen men and put bows to work against the shore stockades.
cause: 朝廷用兵，是被三件事逼出來的。第一，楊幺的船隊已不是零散的湖盜水賊，而是一支能在湖上長期活動、兵農相兼、屯墾自給的成建制武裝，水寨數十處環湖分據，車船、海鰍船數百只，糧食來源不仰賴官軍，等於在長江中游之側另立了一個不受朝廷節制的政權；紹興三年四月楊幺奉鍾子義為太子、自號大聖天王建楚，界域北至公安、東達岳州，與北方南下的戰線夾在江漢與洞庭之間，朝廷不能容忍。第二，先前的招撫已告失敗：紹興元年、二年程昌寓在鼎口、下沚江口兩度進攻失利，楊幺反而在官軍的退路上站穩，說明只要官軍不解決湖上機動的問題，義軍的戰力只會隨田蠶興旺而倍增；紹興二年田蠶豐收、實力倍增的記述，正是這個判斷的依據。第三，北方金人南下的壓力未解，朝廷擔心洞庭義軍與北方抗金武裝相應，一旦湖中舟軍西引，江淮與荊襄的防線就要兩面受敵。於是朝廷不再議撫，改為自六月起調集禁軍、水軍與船隻糧食，於十月入湖，企圖以兵力與糧秣的絕對優勢，把楚軍從水寨中逼出來決戰。
causeEn: The court was driven to war by three things. First, Yang Yao fleet was no longer a band of lake pirates but an organised force able to operate on the lake for long periods, farming and fighting at once, sustaining itself without drawing on the government; some dozens of stockades ringed the lake, several hundred traction-wheel ships and sea-loach junks were on the water, and the food supply did not depend on the Song, so that a second polity had grown up beside the middle Yangtze that the court could not control. In the fourth month of 1133 Yang Yao installed Zhong Ziyi as heir, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Heavenly King and established the government of Chu over territory reaching north to Gong an and east to Yuezhou, sitting between the Jin advance from the north and the river defences of the middle Yangtze; the court could not tolerate this. Second, the attempt to appease them had already failed: in the first and second years of Shaoxing Cheng Changyu was twice defeated at Dingkou and Xiazhi Jiang, and Yang Yao instead took a firm footing on the very ground from which the government troops had retreated, which showed that as long as the court could not solve the problem of mobility on the lake, the insurgents would only grow stronger, and the entry for 1132 that the harvest of grain and silkworm was good and the strength doubled is precisely the reasoning on which the case rested. Third, the Jin pressure from the north had not been lifted, and the court feared that the Dongting insurgents would make contact with the anti-Jin armed bands in the north, so that if the lake fleet were drawn westward the defences of the Yangtze and Huai and of Jingxiang would be attacked from two sides at once. So the court stopped discussing terms and began to gather the imperial guard, the water force, the boats and the grain from the sixth month, entering the lake in the tenth month in the hope that the sheer weight of men and provisions would force the Chu out of their stockades and into a decisive battle.
impact: 陽武口一戰的影響，落在三個層面。第一是湖南的軍事地理：官軍第一次在洞庭湖上折戟，說明江防編制的舟師不適合在汊口密布、洲渚棋布的內陸湖沼作戰，帆檣施展不開、編隊一入水汊便被切斷，兵力優勢反成各個擊破的對象。此後南宋在湖南的用兵由深入求戰轉為扼口設寨、持久消耗，水寨、屯田、小舟擾敵並用，直至紹興五年岳飛接手才以誘敵入狹水、火攻截斷的辦法收局。第二是楚政權的壽命：陽武口與社木寨前後得手，使楊幺的水軍在紹興二年至三年達到頂點，界域北至公安、南抵潭州，自號大聖天王、奉鍾子義為太子，儼然一國之號；然而這次勝利並未改變其結構性弱點——水寨可守不可出，一旦朝廷改以屯田與持久戰對付，義軍的田蠶收益與舟船優勢都會被慢慢耗掉。第三是舟船技術的傳播：義軍的車船與海鰍船在平定後多為官軍所得，南宋軍器隨後仿造，車船之議在宋金戰爭的水戰中反覆出現，成為後世評說中國早期明輪舟的常引實例。
impactEn: The effect of the battle at Yangwukou worked on three levels. The first was the military geography of Hunan. The Song fleet was defeated for the first time on Dongting Lake, which showed that a river-defence flotilla is unsuited to fighting in an inland lake of crowded channels and scattered islets: the sails cannot be spread, the line of battle is cut up as soon as it enters a waterway, and the superiority in numbers becomes an invitation to be beaten in detail. After this the Song conduct of war in Hunan changed from seeking battle in depth to holding the mouths of the channels, building stockades and winning by attrition, combining camps, reclaimed fields and small-boat harassment, until in the fifth year of Shaoxing Yue Fei took over and ended the matter by luring the enemy into narrow water and cutting them off with fire. The second was the life span of the state of Chu. Successes such as Yangwukou and Shumuzhai carried the Yang Yao fleet to its height between the second and third years of Shaoxing, with territory reaching north to Gong an and south to Tanzhou, a proclaimed title of Great Sage Heavenly King and an heir taken from the house of Zhong Xiang, all the marks of a state. Yet the victory changed none of the structural weakness: the stockades could be held but not left, and once the court switched to farming and patience, the returns from grain and silkworm and the advantage of the boats would be slowly used up. The third was the spread of the ship types. The traction-wheel ships and sea-loach junks of the insurgents passed into the hands of the government troops after the rising was put down, the Southern Song arsenal copied them, and the traction-wheel ship went on appearing repeatedly in the naval fighting of the Song and Jin wars, becoming a stock example cited in later discussions of the early Chinese paddle-wheel vessel.
result: 結果是宋軍在洞庭湖上的第一次大規模進剿徹底失敗，並且是在取得局部小勝之後被翻盤。十月十九日，王燮部與楊幺車船水軍短兵相接，敗退橋口；十月下旬王𤫉轉從上游進剿、留兵設伏於洞庭湖口與牌口，本待楚軍敗退時攔殺，楊幺卻將計就計，移上游諸寨民眾牲畜至酉港，以部分水軍牽制上游宋軍，另以數千人乘車船數隻偃旗息鼓順流東下。十一月十日，崔增、吳全率數百舟船入湖追擊，將至陽武口水面忽寬，楚軍車船水軍擂鼓橫衝，把宋軍舟船全部撞沉，崔增、吳全及所部萬餘人一併覆沒；同日王𤫉、程昌寓率三萬步騎自下沚江口水陸並進，逐寨圍剿而所至皆空寨。楚軍班師回酉港，集中車船水軍再敗王𤫉主力。此役之後，朝廷罷王𤫉，改由程昌寓主持湖南軍事，軍隊退守上沚江口，雙方在湖汊中形成僵持；洞庭之亂最終在紹興五年由岳飛統兵入湖、以誘敵與火攻收束，楊幺兵敗被擒，楚政權覆亡。
resultEn: The result was that the Song first large-scale attempt to reduce Dongting failed completely, and it failed after a local success had been turned against them. On the nineteenth day of the tenth month the detachment of Wang Xie fought the Chu traction-wheel flotilla at close quarters and was beaten back to Qiaokou. Later in the tenth month Wang Gui switched to advancing from the upper reaches and left troops in ambush at the mouth of Dongting Lake and at Paikou, expecting the Chu to retreat into them; Yang Yao turned the plan against him, moving the people and livestock of the upstream camps to Yougang, engaging the Song upstream with part of his water force and sending several thousand men down the current in a few traction-wheel ships with flags furled and drums silent. On the tenth day of the eleventh month Cui Zeng and Wu Quan took several hundred boats into the lake in pursuit; as they neared Yangwukou the water suddenly widened, the Chu traction-wheel fleet beat its drums and charged in a mass, rammed the Song boats to the bottom and destroyed Cui Zeng, Wu Quan and more than ten thousand of their men. On the same day Wang Gui and Cheng Changyu advanced out of Xiazhi Jiang with thirty thousand foot and horse and the water force of Dingzhou, by land and water at once, hunting down the lakeside stockades one by one, only to find every camp empty. The Chu withdrew to Yougang, gathered the traction-wheel fleet and defeated Wang Gui main body once more. After this the court dismissed Wang Gui and left Cheng Changyu to direct the military affairs of Hunan; the troops withdrew to guard Xiazhi Jiang, and the two sides settled into a stalemate among the lake channels. The Dongting rising was finally closed out in the fifth year of Shaoxing, when Yue Fei took over the command, entered the lake, lured the insurgents into narrow water and cut them off with fire; Yang Yao was defeated and taken, and the state of Chu perished.
